account_preconditions: exact account region and Binance Stocks access are eligible
FPSL is currently offered to the account and the account truthfully satisfies at least one published eligibility criterion
the stock inventory already exists independently of FPSL and is fully settled
the user separately authorizes the external-state enrollment change after reviewing the disclosures
economics_preconditions: owned loan records prove exact symbol shares and days actually on loan
owned records prove the exact annualized lending rate and user share percentage rather than importing an Alpaca retail rate
owned monthly FPSL distributions reconcile to the daily loan records
incremental interest remains positive after cash_in_lieu dividend tax treatment SIPC coverage loss custody counterparty support and operating costs
decision_gate.promotion_rule: promote only after at least three independent monthly owned distribution cycles are positive after every incremental cost and no stock was bought retained transferred or left unhedged to manufacture the overlay

distinctness.reason: FPSL pays a share of securities borrowing income only when independently existing settled native stock inventory is actually loaned; the incremental cash flow does not require a price forecast or new trading volume

economics.incremental_only_scope: stock already independently owned and intended to remain held regardless of FPSL
economics.interest_accrual: daily only while shares are actually on loan
economics.interest_payment: end of the following month with at least three working days processing
economics.sale_liquidity: the holder may sell at any time and the loan is automatically recalled with interest stopping at sale
economics.settlement_requirement: eligible stocks must already be purchased and settled before becoming available for lending

expired_discovery_activity.role: expired announcement discovered the continuing FPSL product and independently confirms its monthly interest mechanics

official_sources.role: current FPSL mechanics eligibility cashflow timing and risk disclosure
expired leaderboard terms plus independent description of continuing monthly FPSL interest

account_eligibility_any_one: Spot plus Funding account balance at least 2500 USD
liquid assets or net worth at least 20000 USD
at least one year of stock investment experience
product_terms.eligible_assets: fully settled eligible U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs held through Binance Stocks

prohibited_shortcuts: buying transferring or retaining stock to create FPSL eligibility
treating enrollment or eligible holdings as proof that any share will be loaned
importing Alpaca direct retail or Elite fee share percentages into the Binance account contract
treating a displayed annualized borrow rate as an owned realized distribution
crediting the expired HODL leaderboard vouchers as current forward value
ignoring cash_in_lieu dividend tax treatment voting-right loss or missing SIPC coverage while shares are on loan
enabling FPSL answering suitability questions or changing account state without explicit user authority
calling gross positive interest stable profitable or deployment ready before owned after-cost recurrence
risk_and_limitations: there is no guarantee any eligible stock will be loaned
the annualized lending rate changes with market demand and the Binance user share percentage is not public in the bound sources
loan information can lag by two business days
shares on loan are not covered by SIPC
the holder loses voting rights while shares are on loan
dividends on loaned shares are paid as cash_in_lieu and may have different tax treatment
public documentation does not prove account region product availability owned settled inventory or any distribution
